model_metadata.model_name: GhostLayer Analytical Kernel & Memory Projection Engine
model_metadata.methodology: Analytical tensor-core occupancy estimation combined with contiguous VRAM page defragmentation models.

analytical_kernel_estimator.description: Calculates FlashAttention-2 tile-level block fusion speedup by replacing un-fused PyTorch intermediate memory write-backs with L1/L2 SRAM cache accumulation.
assumptions: SRAM tile size 128x128 FP16 tensor-core execution
Zero intermediate VRAM DRAM bandwidth bottlenecking
PCIe Gen4 x16 or NVLink3 interconnect
limitations: Assumes batch size > 8 for tensor-core saturation
Model accuracy degrades under extreme sequence lengths (>32k tokens) without Chunked-Prefill

paged_vram_model.description: Estimates VRAM memory footprint reduction by eliminating PyTorch allocator page fragmentation via contiguous 2MB huge-page pre-allocation.
assumptions: Zero active OOM memory pressure prior to hook insertion
limitations: Actual reclaim varies depending on dynamic batching variance
